summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I ran the program, found two bugs, and fixed both. `main.py` imported from a nonexistent `greetings` module, so I changed it to `greeter`, and `greeter.py` was missing a colon after `def greet(name)`. `python3 main.py` now runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world!
